title: neilson: wired frosted-glass shader over green foliage
note: Glass texture inspo. A real-time browser piece (running on localhost) by neilson (games, product @theworldlabs & @amd, oakwood st. studio), posted 2026-11-06 with no caption: a pane of pebbled, frosted wired glass with a fine grid of wire lines over out-of-focus green leaves; a bright hotspot of light slides across and the foliage refracts and blurs through the bumps. Filmed on a phone pointed at the monitor. 7.5 s clip, no sound. Thumbnail is a frame from the clip.
